title: Concealed Under-Deck Tuned Mass Damper for 40 m Footbridge Vertical Comfort
problem_restatement: Limit first vertical bending response of the 40 m footbridge near 1.9 Hz at midspan to comfortable acceleration below the 0.5 m/s2 maximum-comfort limit.
mechanism_sentence: Two 200 kg under-deck masses on coil springs and viscous dampers tuned to 1.86 Hz vibrate out of phase with the 1.9 Hz midspan bending mode to add effective damping and limit vertical acceleration.
decisive_choices: Place two 200 kg modules at midspan below soffit where first vertical bending motion is maximum
Tune 400 kg system to 1.86 Hz with 0.086 TMD damping ratio for ~2% mass ratio
Carry units on bolted cross-frames between girders with 30 mm clearance, no deck penetration and below-deck hatch access
open_question: What are the vertical acceleration and TMD stroke at -5% detune and do they remain below 0.5 m/s2 and within 30 mm clearance?
transfer_line: Load: pedestrian walking force -> deck and girders -> TMD units | Measured: deck acceleration -> comfort class

assumed_constraints.constraint: 40 m footbridge first vertical bending mode near 1.9 Hz with peak motion at midspan
Single pedestrian resonant baseline ~1.75 m/s2 above 0.5 m/s2 maximum-comfort limit
Concealed fit below soffit with 30 mm stroke clearance and no fixings through deck wearing surface, access from below
Added mass 400 kg as two 200 kg modules with bolted support design load ~3924 N static
assumed_constraints.source: E4 optimal TMD sizing, E9 static weight calculation

functional_decomposition: Limit first vertical bending response near 1.9 Hz to comfortable acceleration
Provide tuned mass damping at midspan with added viscous damping
Support added mass on concealed under-deck frame without changing deck view
Allow below-deck installation, inspection and re-tuning

concept.working_principle: Under-deck vertical tuned mass damper at midspan tuned to 1.86 Hz with ~2% modal mass ratio and viscous damping resonates out of phase with the 1.9 Hz first vertical bending mode to add effective damping above 3% and limit acceleration below 0.5 m/s2 while hidden below the soffit.

fabrication_steps.description: Install galvanized bolted cross-frames between existing girders from below with four M16 preloaded bolts per module, no fixings through wearing surface
Mount two 200 kg TMD modules on coil springs and viscous dampers with slotted spring seats, set 30 mm stroke clearance
Fit lockable access hatches from below, soffit-matched finish, corrosion protection and shim re-tuning provision

risks.risk: Added 400 kg under-deck mass causes bolted connection and girder fatigue failure
risks.mitigation: Size four preloaded M16 bolts per module for ~4373 N peak and verify ~7 MPa per bolt and ~2.5 MPa static plus ~0.3 MPa dynamic girder stress as fatigue-non-critical per Eurocode 3

risks.risk: Frequency drift off-tune loses comfort and stroke margin
risks.mitigation: Retain slotted spring seats and shims for re-tuning, verified 0.064 effective damping and 0.136 m/s2 at +5% detune within 30 mm clearance

novelty_claim: Concealed under-deck two-module TMD hidden below soffit with zero change above deck, no fixings through wearing surface and below-deck lockable hatch access.
